name: Gakkou no Kaidan
summary: Gakkou no Kaidan is an anthology horror series centered on ghost stories and urban legends that take place in and around Japanese schools. Each episode presents a standalone tale, often involving students who encounter unexplained phenomena—such as mysterious disappearances, haunted classrooms, cursed objects, or the lingering spirits of the dead. The stories draw from traditional folklore and modern urban myths, exploring the intersection of childhood innocence and supernatural fear. Though the characters and settings change with each episode, the series maintains a consistent tone of quiet dread and psychological unease, emphasizing the idea that even ordinary school life can conceal terrifying secrets.

previousepisode.name: Gakkou no Kaidan: Haru no Noroi

name: Saare Jahan Se Accha
summary: A resilient Indian spy must defeat his counterpart across the border in a battle of wits and tradecraft to sabotage their nuclear program.

name: The Echoes of Survivors: Inside Korea's Tragedies
summary: This documentary series reveals the harrowing tales of those who survived Korea's gloomiest chapters, shedding a light on long-hidden truths.

previousepisode.name: Sampoong Department Store — The Building Built on Greed

name: Berlin Noir
summary: Berlin Noir, based on Philip Kerr's novel Metropolis, follows Bernie Gunther's early career as he rises through the ranks of the Berlin Murder Squad. The story is set against the backdrop of Weimar-era Berlin, a city marked by both unprecedented freedom and growing political instability. As Gunther investigates these seemingly random killings, he confronts a society on the cusp of radical change, with the shadow of the Nazi party growing ever larger. The series explores themes of truth, justice, and survival in a city teetering on the edge of chaos, as Bernie navigates a world where the rules are constantly shifting and the line between right and wrong blurs.

name: The Yogurt Shop Murders
summary: In 1991, four teenage girls were brutally murdered at a frozen yogurt shop in Austin, Texas. What happened that night forever shook the Austin community and continues to mystify the police and haunt the families left in the wake of unthinkable loss. Including interviews with the investigative teams, the victims' parents and siblings, and the two men who served time for the crime, the series explores law enforcement practices and raises complex questions about press coverage and the power of suggestion on memory. The series offers a unique window into the lasting effects of grief and the enduring impact of unrelenting crime coverage in mainstream media through poignant interviews with those closest to the crime and investigation.

name: Taurasi
summary: Taurasi chronicling the extraordinary journey of basketball legend Diana Taurasi, whose relentless pursuit of greatness has transcended the boundaries of sport.

name: Body in the Water
summary: Body in the Water uncovers the complexities of murder cases in which the victim's body is found in water – often far from the original crime scene. Whether used to stage an accident, destroy evidence, or serve as a deposition site, water makes processing a crime scene infinitely more difficult. From tidal movement to trace evidence loss, each case presents a forensic puzzle.

name: Murder: Point of Contact
summary: Murder: Point of Contact explores landmark cases and reveals how the FLO role has become a cornerstone of modern policing following the Stephen Lawrence Inquiry, offering a nuanced view of how families and police navigate the aftermath of murder together.

name: Xu Ni Bu Er Zhi Chen
Murder Down Under: Byron Bay Murders
summary:
The two-part true crime special will explore a haunting pattern of disappearances of young women aged 14 to 20 between Newcastle and Byron Bay that have remained unsolved for decades, with not a single arrest made. 

A passionate Member of Parliament, Jeremy Buckingham, leads the investigation, driven by personal tragedy. Following his son's devastating suicide, Jeremy stumbled upon the alarming cluster of unsolved missing persons cases and his grief propelled him to bring the issue to Parliament to demand answers in the hope of giving these women a voice and their families closure. 

Former Detective Sergeant Damian Loone, criminal psychologist Tim Watson Munro and criminologist Xanthe Mallett will examine the evidence of these cases and investigate all the relevant material in an effort to break new ground.

name: BKB: Bare Knuckle Boxing
summary: Bare Knuckle Boxing is growing faster than any other sport, with a trajectory that mirrors MMA twenty-five years ago, and that growth and popularity will only accelerate as Vice TV builds out Vice Sports.

name: The Mother Flip
summary: Best friends and savvy flippers Kristy Etheredge and Rebecca Franchione, along with contractor Roy Salinas, transform the worst homes in Texas' Hill Country into big profits. With all-cash deals and strategic renovations, they take bold risks to turn rundown properties into real estate gold—splitting the massive payday three ways.

name: The Real Housewives of London
summary: The 30th installment of the iconic franchise and the second to be set in England. Join the latest batch of woman living their lives for the camera.

name: The Trouble with Tessa
summary:
After Tessa Fowler's skyrocketing career implodes overnight, the disgraced documentarian escapes to a small, idyllic mountain town called Lowery. It seems like the perfect place to hide: Lowery doesn't allow cellphones, doesn't have internet, and no one knows about Tessa's past.

Tessa's determination to leave their investigative days behind them disappears, however, when they find a mysterious box of recordings in their rental home's dingy basement. At first, the recordings seem to be nothing more than security footage. However, when Tessa plays a tape that appears to catch a murder in progress, they can't help but start digging into this seemingly perfect town's disturbing past.

name: To Kill A Monkey
summary: An old friend coaxes Efemini into the alluring world of cybercrime, where every decision he makes draws him deeper into a moral minefield.

name: My Secret of Seer
summary: The story of Win, a 25-year-old fortune teller who is about to meet his end if he doesn't find someone with integrity to help him, and Phloeng, a ghost show host who doesn't believe in ghosts but is the person Win needs. When the two join forces on a ghost hunting show, a story of conflict between physics and black magic, and a war between belief and disbelief begins.

name: Flavor of Us
summary: Meekhun is a famous food critic. Faced with an enormous debt his mother has amassed, he has no idea how he can possibly fix it. It's hard to see if it's a blessing or a curse when he suddenly finds himself the sole inheritor of his grandfather's restaurant. The restaurant is located on a small island quickly becoming a tourist spot. If he were to sell it, the money would be more than enough to pay off what his mother owes. Nothing is ever so easy, however. There's a caveat. Meekhun will only be permitted to sell the restaurant and the land it sits on when he's run the business for one year. Meekhun's biggest headache, however, is the restaurant's chef his grandfather has specified in his will.

name: Truck Dynasty
summary:
Florida's Apocalypse Manufacturing owner Joe Ghattas is a self-made boss in the custom truck industry, known for his bold designs and loyal following that includes hardcore enthusiasts, world-famous rappers, sports superstars, and elite supermodels. Alongside his wife and co-owner Ashley, he designs, fabricates, and sells these outrageous custom creations. No design is too wild for them to build – ranging from an Apocalypse Hellfire with a pull-out mobile kitchen for legendary chef Guy Fieri or an Apocalypse Super Truck with superhero branding for NBA champion Shaquille O'Neal. With the support of his in-laws, who run sales and marketing for the business, Joe is on the brink of breaking through the fiercely competitive marketplace to establish an American auto brand in a category all its own.  

From a high-water emergency response vehicle built for fire departments to traverse downed palm trees to a ‘Boat Truck' – an amphibious Jeep that cruises the highway and dives straight into the water Truck Dynasty showcases next-level creations built to conquer land, water, and everything in between.

name: The Story of Ruoxi
summary: Despite being a bottom-tier palace maid, Wu Ruoxi has been on a meteoric rise since she entered the palace. With beauty that captures the emperor's heart and cunning that outmaneuvers the harem's schemes, she crushes rivals, avenges enemies, and claws her way to the top! Yet, the harem is too small for a true phoenix. Her ambition soars higher.

previousepisode.name: From the Famine to the Future

name: Hell for Leather: The Story of Gaelic Football
summary: The story of a game born out of necessity, dreamt up by a nation in search of a social identity and an indigenous sport that could challenge the pre-eminence of foreign games.

name: Murder Down Under: Natural Born Killer
summary: The murder of Stephanie Scott in 2015 shocked Australia: the local schoolteacher and young bride-to-be was brutally slaughtered at her workplace.
Every noon at exactly 12:13, a mysterious Instagram account post embarrassing photos about the students in 6th grade.

name: Naming the Dead
summary: There are 50,000 bodies lying unnamed and unmourned across America with no way of identifying them, until now. This powerful new series follows the DNA Doe Project - a leading organization in genetic investigation and identification - as they partner with law enforcement agencies to solve the coldest of cases, name these unidentified bodies, and bring resolution to families across the country.

name: Traveling with Snow Man
summary: An undisputed top idol group in today's Japanese entertainment industry, this show will be Snow Man's first-ever travel reality show. The concept of the show will involve the Snow Man members taking a break from their busy everyday lives to travel around Japan, where they will share their true feelings and dreams with each other in a natural and unfiltered state while enjoying local travel spots in Japan.

name: Thirteen Against Fate
summary: Series of crime stories from the non-Maigret work of author Georges Simenon.

name: Boris
summary: Boris is a bear with a strong personality. Stubborn and mischievous, he loves his toys but tends to make life difficult for them.

name: Le Pépin de Boris
summary: Boris is the happiest bear ever! But one day, his parents start whispering: he's going to have a little brother! He can't wait, but no one warned him that it would be a drooling baby who doesn't even talk!

name: Les évangéliques à la conquête du monde
summary: From the Cold War to the present day, the expansion of evangelicalism has fostered the emergence of Christian fundamentalism. In three parts, this in-depth investigation reveals the inner workings of a formidable political-religious machine determined to extend its influence over consciences.

name: Keibuho Yabe Kenzo
summary: The credit hogging police officer Yabe Kenzo in Trick now takes center stage. He saves the Japanese public from various evil doers not with his wit or his bravery, but with sheer stupid luck.

previousepisode.name: わしの（最終）伝説 その(8)：殺人同窓会 矢部謙三よ永遠に…

name: Keibuho Yabe Kenzo: Zunou vs Zumou
summary: The arrogant Yabe Kenzo, who has been unwittingly solving difficult cases thanks to a combination of good luck and mix-ups around him, returns with his subordinate Akiba Harando, the computer nerd. Although the submissive Akiba does not shrink back from Yabe's treatment, something unusual arises in their relationship this time. Yabe finds himself squaring off against his strongest rival to date. Genius scientist Deep Manabu, who has invented "God Eye Joe", artificial intelligence customized for criminal investigations, has been solving successive cases that even the FBI and Scotland Yard have given up on. He announces that he will use it to catch a murderer called the "referee of the dark", whom the Japanese police are helpless against. With no room to maneuver, the police commissioner assigns Yabe to be the full-time investigator in order to shift responsibility. Unaware of this, Yabe heads to a hot spring area with eyewitness sightings of the "referee of the dark" in high spirits. There is a landslide, and an inn is cut off like a remote island. Then, a company president who is a guest at the inn is murdered. Under Yabe's supervision, the proprietress of the inn, Yamakawa Tamao and her guests split into groups to search the surroundings for clues. The murderer's personal effects are discovered in the direction of the woods, and Yabe gives chase with Akiba. Meanwhile, Deep Manabu has been at work on analyzing the case. A fierce battle of wits is about to unfold between the man with the wig and the man who uses artificial intelligence in the investigation of this bloodthirsty killer.

name: Millennium Storm
summary: IT prodigy Li Tian and his best friend Zhang Liang are hurled back to the turn of the millennium. Li Tian wakes up saddled with debt and an unfamiliar wife. To pay off his creditors and start from scratch, he launches a business with the help of a close female confidante. But success pits him against the very brother he once trusted, dragging them both into a cut-throat commercial war. As the hostile takeover escalates, the truth behind Li Tian's soul-swap begins to surface.

name: Vipo: Adventures of the Flying Dog
Edges of Empire
summary: Tristan Hughes goes on a journey along Hadrian's Wall, visiting some of its greatest sites. Meeting experts to learn more about the Wall's history and the ground-breaking new archaeological discoveries, that continue to tell us more about what life must have been like on this far-flung frontier almost 2,000 years ago.

name: Poisonous love
summary: Love is a poison, intoxicating the hearts. Yet, in the end, it's poisonous love that makes the hearts race.

name: Queendom

summary: Rey and Print, rivals since school years, meet again as lead roles for the most anticipated drama of the year. One week before the camera rolls, Ray and Prin wake up and find that their souls have transported into each other's body! The body-switch chaos begins amidst production as Rey and Print try their best to impersonate each other on set. But the most important question should be: what is the heart-thumping feeling that Rey and Print start to develop for each other?

name: Player
summary: When Pun, a young graphic designer who recently graduated from a foreign country with a master's degree, has to track down Petai, her future husband (fake). The one who took her money through Ploy, the charming and mysterious villain who was his younger sister. The game of flirting begins with a trick. But it turned out to be a true feeling that was hard to resist. When two tigers pretend to be prey in a game of hearts.

name: The Love Never Sets
summary: After being violated by Mint, Ice dropped out of school but was forced into the adult film industry. Now, he's returning to school and is set to shoot a gay-themed movie, with his co-star being none other than Saint, with whom he had a falling out. When the two meet again, Ice confronts Saint with his pent-up resentment, yet during the filming, they engage in the most intimate acts that the closest of people would do.

name: Marriage Plan: Moto Otto no Kekkonshiki wo Planning Shimashita
SEC Football: Any Given Saturday
summary: SEC Football: Any Given Saturday takes fans deep inside the Southeastern Conference (SEC) during the 2024 season, offering unprecedented access to the players, coaches, and programs that define the sport's most dominant league.

name: Danefæ
summary: Danefæ follows archaeologist couple Ester and Michael Toksvig as their marriage and careers collide. While Michael leads a major national museum exhibition, Ester works at a small Viking museum and discovers a thousand-year-old murder that could rewrite Danish history. As ambition and betrayal surface, Ester fights to uncover the truth and reclaim her voice in both history and her own life.

name: Grethe
summary: Meet the Bynke family: Father Jørgen, mother Charlotte and the three children Ingrid, Frederikke and Valdemar. And not to forget - Jørgen's sister, Clara, who lives in the attic. The family lives a chaotic life, where everything is a mess, mother and father drive each other crazy, and a copper wedding must be planned. The children live through camera lenses and tablets in their own worlds. Jørgen and Charlotte decide that they must have a young girl in the house. But a young girl it will not be.

name: NORAID: Irish America and the IRA
Buy my boss
summary: Recent graduate Manfan faces bankruptcy, heartbreak, and misfortune. Seeking solace, she hires escort Araya, unaware her new boss Issara is the same person, leading to an unexpected revelation.

name: Sunshine in the Wind
summary: The life of Phraphye, a kind-hearted woman who owns a flower shop. What makes her unique is her incredible ability to smell emotions through the fragrance of flowers. One day, she is entrusted with the task of delivering a bouquet to the movie gala where Vadthiwa, the lead actress, is being honoured. Upon meeting Vadthiwa, Phraphye immediately senses a deep sadness emanating from her. As their friendship blossoms, Vadthiwa and Phraphye begin to realize that they have feelings for each other. Throughout the series, we see the relationship between Vadthiwa and Phraphye grow. Parallel to this, we also witness the budding romance between Phanmile and Khian-Tawan.

name: 3 Minutes 2 Love
summary: The girl (bodyguard) was saved when she was a child and got special power of seeing the future 3 min in advance. Present time, she is hired by the father of Pleng to bring Pleng back and protect her before her wedding. Bodyguard has to drink water or be in contact with water to see the future to protect Pleng. Suspense and love are the theme

name: Love Design
summary: The story of two female architects who were once in love. However, when one discovers that her partner stole her work to use in a competition, their relationship turns into a bitter rivalry. As former lovers become business rivals, they employ various strategies to outmaneuver each other, while navigating a complicated love triangle when a third person enters their lives.

name: Shades
summary: At Thailand's most elite girls' school, rules are made to be broken. Six students and one teacher ignite a firestorm of scandal, desire, and digital revolution. As hidden loves and explosive secrets collide, they'll shatter the myth of the good girl and redefine what it means to grow up in the age of viral videos and cancel culture.

name: The Edge
summary: A three-part anthology suspense program in which men and women face life's ultimate danger zone. Each episode is introduced by a mysterious figure known as The Watcher (Barry Sattels), who arrives on the scene just as strange things being to happen - pushing men and women in crisis over the edge and into bizarre, unexpected actions.

name: Remain
summary: After a tragic accident, a young woman wakes up with amnesia and no recollection of her past. While piecing together her identity, she crosses paths with a compassionate mine owner who offers her shelter and a fresh start. As their connection deepens, fragments of her former life begin to return—along with hidden family conflicts and societal pressures. Caught between repressed desires and haunting memories, she must decide whether to trust her heart or walk away from a love that may have been destined to end.

name: The Tipsy Mystery
summary: The story follows Phing, a famous spirit medium who unexpectedly gets involved in a wild party called Paradise Seven, a hotspot for hot young people, including four notorious playboys: Pi, Ter, Jock and Dung. Also present is Bam, a stunning and alluring woman who sets the party ablaze. With everyone drinking excessively and letting loose, the night spirals into chaos. The next morning, everyone wakes up to a shocking sight, Bam's lifeless body. Phing, who happens to witness the scene, attempts to use her abilities to communicate with Bam's spirit and uncover her killer. Unfortunately, although she manages to contact her, Bam was so drunk on the night of the murder that even her ghost can't remember what happened. The chaos escalates further when Lieutenant Dan, a passionate cop, steps in to investigate the case personally. With everything growing even more complicated, the big question remains, can Phing help Bam's spirit find the truth?

name: Villa der Versuchung
summary: Villa der Versuchung (German for "Villa of Temptation") is a reality TV series where 14 celebrities move into a paradise villa for two weeks, with every attempt at comfort or luxury costing them from a €250,000 prize pool, as orchestrated by Verona Pooth.

name: Cooper & Fry
summary: Set in the mystery-shrouded Peak District, the series follows two mismatched young detectives: affable local Ben Cooper and guarded newcomer Diane Fry. Thrown together to investigate a string of mysterious deaths they must learn to work together to get results. As their personal lives begin to intertwine, a unique friendship begins to form... But it won't always be easy.

name: Benidorm Is Murder
summary: Former detective Dennis Crown has swapped the chaos of the UK for a quieter life running a bar in Benidorm. But when tourists start turning up dead, he's reluctantly drawn back into detective work—egged on by his barmaid Rosa, a crime drama superfan. With Dennis's real-world experience and Rosa's encyclopaedic TV knowledge, each episode sees the duo tackling a new murder in paradise, whilst trying to remain on the right side of the local Spanish cops.

name: Number One Fan
summary:
The series focuses on Morning show presenter Lucy, who is saved from an attack by a strange woman named Donna who claims to be her number one fan.

Lucy's gratitude quickly sours when Donna's fandom turns into a darker obsession infiltrating Lucy's career, family and friends. However to her horror Lucy comes to realise that Donna has a link to a hidden secret in her past which threatens to derail the career she has so carefully curated.

name: Missed Call
summary:
When British teenager Katie Gleason vanishes during a school exchange in southern France, her mother Sarah rushes to Saint-Michel seeking answers.

Met with evasive police and hostility from Katie's powerful host family, the Morvans, Sarah launches her own investigation alongside local detective Lieutenant Virginie Taylor, exposing buried secrets, abuse, corruption, and trafficking within the tight-knit town.

As bodies surface and suspicions reach influential figures - including Virginie's father - alliances fracture. Betrayed and unraveling, Sarah learns that Katie may still be alive. Time is running out for them both and justice.

name: The Fortune
summary: Amanda Blakefield's life is a happy one, with her husband Jimmy and their son Luke. But when Amanda is left an enormous inheritance by a man she has neither met nor heard of before, her life starts to fall apart. Amanda becomes embroiled in the world of the Worralls, where Martin Worrall is head of a family bound in past secrets. As Amanda is drawn further and further into past events and relationships, all of their lives are turned upside down.

name: The Imposter
summary: A splashy seaside hotel becomes the centre of a bitter family dispute as matriarch Helen refuses to sell, despite pressure from her three adult children. But Helen is hiding a secret: a daughter she gave up for adoption decades ago. When Amanda suddenly appears, Helen welcomes her with open arms— but is Amanda who she says she is? The lucrative hotel is the ultimate prize and a twisted scheme soon spirals into betrayal and ultimately, murder.

name: What A Lovely Day
summary: After a workplace betrayal forces Nan Cheng to rethink her life in the big city, she returns to her hometown, Ali Village, for a break. There, she meets the privileged Ding Keqin. Their rocky first encounter soon turns into something more, and through life's ups and downs, they gradually heal each other and find a brighter future together.

name: Wish You All The Best
summary: In Changle, maritime trade thrived despite the sea ban. Deputy commander Pei You An was drawn into a fierce battle when Japanese pirates attacked merchant ships, including Zhen Jia Fu's. To save her from a forced marriage, he signed a contract with her, sparking a love tested by hardship…

name: The Vanishing Beauty
summary: Yu Meng, an only child from Jiangsu Zhejiang Shanghai and a popular internet blogger, is admired as a woman with a perfect life. On her fifth wedding anniversary, the bubble of her seemingly flawless happiness shatters. Her model husband is no longer so perfect, and her marriage begins to crack, while she also faces the threat of being financially exploited. With the support of her friends, Yu Meng reexamines her life and fights to take back control.

name: Winds Beyond the Wall
summary:
Set during the late Qing dynasty, the story follows Yu Chuhao, an academic official who returns to his hometown of Liuli Village in western Fujian. When his clan faces a crisis, he steps forward to protect them, only for the Qing Empire to collapse the next day.

Centered around the century-old earthen fortress of Liuli Village, the story spans several generations and time periods, portraying the lives of its residents as they struggle to survive in turbulent times. Through moments of love, loss, loyalty, and conflict, the series captures how ordinary people navigate history's great changes—revealing a vivid portrait of resilience, humanity, and the passage of time within one enduring village.

name: Chuan Jin Sai Bo You Xi Hou Gan Diao Boss Cheng Gong Shang Wei
Detective Hours: In Our Prime
summary: Set in the 1990s, the series follows Chinese criminal investigators as they solve a string of major crimes that shook society. Through breakthroughs in investigation, forensic science, and technology, these young officers risk everything in their pursuit of justice and truth.

name: The Palace Stewardess
summary: The Palace Stewardess tells the story of Zhao Ai, the second prince who returns to Nanshao after being held hostage, and Wu Zhenzhen, an orphan who enters the palace under the identity of a false noble daughter to avenge her mother. What begins as mutual suspicion gradually turns into a bond of trust through life and death trials. In the end, Zhao Ai restores order to the court and revives proper rule, while Wu Zhenzhen rises to become the The Palace Stewardess, overseeing the Six Palace Bureaus. Together, they protect the future of their family and country.

name: Remnants of Gold
summary: Three hundred thousand taels of gold suddenly surface in the vast desert, where rumor has it that all who seek the treasure are doomed to become vengeful spirits. An officer of the Imperial Guard sent to investigate descends into madness on his very first day. A loyal and courageous deputy envoy who has ventured too far to turn back finds himself torn between desire and honor. After her entire family is slaughtered, a woman immune to all poisons returns to the vast desert, deliberately making herself the prize every faction is determined to seize as she sets out for revenge. Beneath the vast desert's sweeping sands lie an insatiable greed for gold and a carefully laid trap designed to lure her into the deadly game. From a relay station and an armed escort agency to a general's residence, a band of martial heroes becomes entangled in a deadly struggle across the vast and desolate frontier, bringing the spirit and ideals of Eastern wuxia to life in a new light.

name: Are You My First?
summary: In this groundbreaking new dating experiment, the largest, hottest group of virgins ever assembled search for intimacy, love – and maybe their first – in a tropical paradise designed just for them. For the first time, they're free to explore their connections without judgment, allowing these sexy young singles to embark on a heated yet heartfelt journey packed with romantic dates, revealing challenges, and new love interests eager to find "the one."  Who will find that special someone? And who will go home hot, bothered and heartbroken?

name: Beyblade: Metal Fusion
summary: The series follows Gingka Hagane. a young Blader who is searching for his hidden past, together with his partner Storm Pegasus. On his training journey, Gingka stumbles upon Metal Bey City, where he meets new friends and rivals. Gingka intends to defeat the evil Dark Nebula organization and Ryuga, a man with the Forbidden Bey known as Lightning L-Drago.

name: Beyblade Burst
summary:
Valt Aoi is a cheerful boy in the 5th Grade. Crazy about Beyblade, he works hard to better himself at Beyblade with the partner Bey, Valtryek.

Valt's close friend Shu Kurenai, who is regarded as a Beyblade genius, is a participant in the National Tournament and is called one of the "Supreme Four" due to his high influence within the tournament. Valt, who is inspired by Shu, sets his aim towards the National Tournament!

name: Nazis, U-boats and the Battle for the Atlantic
summary:
It was the longest campaign of World War 2 – the Battle of the Atlantic. Between 1939 to 1945 more than 100,000 lives were lost at sea and it brought Britain to the brink of defeat.

At the heart of the battle against the U-boat killing machines of the Kriegsmarine – the German navy - was a small city in Northern Ireland, Londonderry, and the port of Lisahally on the River Foyle.

80 years on, in a new BBC series, experts re-examine some of the pivotal moments of this critical battle. It follows a specialist team who dive into history 20 miles off the north coast of Ireland. The team rediscover the wrecks of some of the deadliest Nazi vessels who stalked the Atlantic convoys, now both resting at the bottom of the Atlantic. The series also unlocks hidden history, revealing unsung heroes and looks back at the human cost of war.

name: Wrong Number
summary: A dangerous encounter that starts with a single phone call saying "I'm going to die"! Woo-tae ends up at Lee-seop's house, completely drunk! What will happen on this perilous first night?

previousepisode.name: The One Who Left, the One Who Came

name: Forklift
summary: In Forklift Victor a forklift driver promoted to warehouse supervisor, finds that upward mobility comes with a cost when his friends and co-workers go from viewing him as their brother to now being part of "Big Brother."

name: Northeast Stories: The Rising Era
summary: Ma Rulong, CEO of Jichun Group, was attacked and left with amnesia. After being taken in by Chen Hong, he became a laborer at her garment shop. He went through experiences like provoking local gangsters, accepting a deathbed guardianship pledge from Uncle Qin, and gradually regaining his memory while pawning his jade pendant. Amid internal strife at Jichun Group, this resurrected man forged a reborn conglomerate to dismantle rival Yongming Group.

name: Reverse 21 Grams
summary: Auxiliary investigator Song Xingye is barred by officer Shang Wei while probing a downtown homicide, only to find his comrade Huang Hai hunted by assassins. Teamed with assistant Zhan Na to decrypt data and with Shang Wei for lightning raids, he unravels the conspiracy and foils a coup. With the covert backing of heiress Zhao Qingyun, the truth is dragged into daylight.

name: The Main Event
summary: Chris Tarrant presides over the chaos as each week two families, seated in the comfort of their homes, are linked up with a team of celebrities in the studio to compete against each other. Some of the questions are general knowledge-based, but there are also treasure hunts, charades and against-the-clock challenges.

name: Zoo Nursery France
summary: From Thoiry to the Auvergne Animal Park, from the Boissière-du-Doré Zoo to the Peaugres Safari Park, via the Cerza Zoo, immerse yourself in a world where newborn, injured, or endangered animals rub shoulders with men and women dedicated to caring for and saving them. The keepers share their daily lives and the special relationships they develop with their charges.

name: Swords of Arabia
summary: The series takes place between the era of Jahiliyya and the beginning of the Umayyad caliphate, and presents the history of the Arab sword by documenting the most important stations that Arabs went through throughout the ages.

name: B-Friend
summary: A girl with no memory, a loyal tomboy doctor, and a resort owner—three women find unexpected love and healing together.

name: Чудотворная
summary: V-XII century. In the dense, almost impassable Siberian taiga lives the family of Old Believers Shlykovs. They keep an ancient miraculous icon, which has saved them from trouble more than once. The icon used to belong to the boyar Morozov and came into their hands after his arrest. Rumors of the numerous miracles performed by this icon spread further and further. The memory of the icon did not die down even after centuries.

name: Zoo nursery
summary: This wildlife series offers a positive, fresh, and hopeful perspective on the animal world. Scientists around the world are working to foster the birth of endangered species and reintroduce them into the wild. The series focuses on showing the unique bonds that develop between baby animals and the caregivers who sometimes act as surrogate parents.

name: America's Heartland
summary: America's Heartland is the only national television series celebrating and profiling the people, places and processes of American agriculture. The program's interesting stories, presented in a visually stunning HD format, help non-farm viewers understand where and how their food, fuel, and fiber are produced.

name: 911: Did the Killer Call?
summary: Three horrific murders. Three different 911 calls. All three callers claim they're innocent — but for the police, the call can reveal so much more than just the facts of the case. Find out which of them is the real killer in disguise.

name: Wili a Tili
summary: Hand puppet adventures with Wili a Tili mouse.

name: Dwdlam
summary: Nursery series in the company of Lowri Williams and the inhabitants of Dwdlam's cloud world. We join Lowri's excursion from cloud to cloud.

name: Darllen 'da fi!
summary: A children's story read by a well-known face.

name: Chong Fan Ni De Xia Tian
Пес Альф
summary: Police friends Roma and Bodya investigate crimes and constantly compete with each other. But they learn what real rivalry is when a new investigator, Alisa, joins their team - bright, smart, witty. The girl will not join herself - but with her shepherd dog Alf, who will significantly strengthen the team. The smart four-legged will bring humor to the police routine, as well as his own understanding of who is theirs and who is a stranger. Will the dog Alf become a full-fledged player, will he actively participate in investigations or will he remain "on guard"?

name: Molly en Wors
summary: A hit Afrikaans sitcom about the slightly dysfunctional Visagie family consisting of Worsman, Molly, their eldest son Vaatjie and daughter Blapsie. Molly is a dental assistant for Dr Procter and Wors is a manager at a car battery dealer.

name: El Marqués
summary: In 1977, the young journalist Onofre Romera returns to his hometown to write an article about the event and finds a traumatized and divided society, families in conflict and a path that will lead him to draw new conclusions and confront the marquis, Don Rafael Pertierra and Medina. Two years earlier, in 1975, the seven weeks preceding the crime were recounted, paying attention to various theories and testimonies.

name: Yozakura Osome
summary:
Osome, who works as a dance and shamisen instructor in Ryogoku, is a former entertainer who lost her parents in a fire at age six and was separated from her older brother during the tragedy. Known as "Yozakura Osome" for her beauty and artistic talents, she once served as the star performer of a theatrical troupe. When Osome asks Sasahara Yahei, a doshin officer at the South Magistrate's Office, to investigate the fire that claimed her parents' lives, she eventually learns from Yoshikawa Tateaki that her father had been a government spy working for the shogunate.

Upon discovering this shocking truth about her father's secret identity, Osome becomes determined to capture the perpetrator responsible for her father's death and to search for her missing brother. This revelation transforms her understanding of her family's past and sets her on a dangerous path toward becoming a covert operative herself. Under Tateaki's guidance and training, Osome resolves to enter the shadowy world of espionage, using her skills as an entertainer as cover for her true mission of seeking justice and family reunion.

name: Pokémon Tales: The Misadventures of Sirfetch'd and Pichu
summary: Pokémon Tales: The Misadventures of Sirfetch'd & Pichu is an epic journey through the wilds of Galar. Our heroes embark on a gallant quest to help and protect Pokémon across the region. Their missions rarely go as planned, but their noble deeds forge their friendship as they step bravely into the unknown. Peril, alliances and rivalries, extraordinary Pokémon, and endless laughs await them.

name: Dos tumbas
summary: Two years after the disappearance of Verónica and Marta, two 16-year-old friends, the investigation is declared closed due to lack of evidence and suspects. The grandmother of one of the two girls, Isabel, who has nothing to lose, decides to carry out an investigation beyond the law. Isabel will do whatever it takes to uncover the truth about what happened that night and what begins as the search for a culprit, soon becomes a story of revenge.

name: La Moderna
summary: Melodrama set in 1930s Madrid, tells the stories of a group of working women from one of the most distinguished tea rooms in the capital.

name: FOX Weather First
summary: Waking up at 5 am to the first live national forecast of the day; all the latest weather news and everything one needs to prepare for the day ahead.

name: Megachu!
summary:
Based on an adult game by Front Wing. 

Kousuke is an everyday nice-guy college kid who suffers from a reoccurring nightmare where he's a rampaging sex demon. He just can't figure out why that is, as he sits down to play his favorite video games like Magical Girl Lape-chan. One day a beautiful Goddess named Fauna appears before him, not to grant wishes, but to destroy him! It seems Kousuke has the power of an evil demon sleeping inside of him. Luckily, Fauna decides on an alternate means of stopping the demon, which involves lots of sex with her and sexy older sister (and love potion maker) Jordh. Unluckily, there's Natsuki, a little devil with plans of her own for Kousuke.

name: La vie de château
summary: After the loss of her parents, 8-year-old Violette is placed with her uncle Régis, a gruff maintenance worker at the Palace of Versailles. Despite a difficult start, Violette and Régis learn to live together and overcome life's challenges. Between floods, complicated friendships, first loves, and a Christmas trip to her grandparents, they gradually build a new life full of discoveries and tender moments in the heart of Versailles.

name: Key to the Phoenix Heart
summary: The evil general forcefully marries the money-grubbing fake heiress who is obsessed with mechanical arts. From a contractual couple to exposing each other's true identities in a life-and-death situation, their mutual love and hatred intensify. They uncover court conspiracies, shatter deadly chaos, and safeguard the peace of the nation.

name: The Best Couple
summary: In the neon-lit alleys, the Renxin Clinic is known for its cold-hearted and money-driven underground doctor, Mu Wan. But behind the façade lies a five-year plan, which her true target is the Dark Empire's heir, Ma Yuting. When he stumbles in, seriously wounded, her deadly game begins. Yet he has long seen through her revenge plot. Between manipulation and temptation, two powerful predators engage in a fierce game of strategy and seduction. Passion ignites in their deadly confrontation. Not only is she his fate, but also the inescapable doom he cannot avoid…

name: Tai Zi Yi Fei Sheng Zhi Ji
Qing Qing Wan Wan Zhen Shang Shi
Spice Up the 80's
summary: In the late 1980s, orphaned Lin Xiaoxiao defies her aunt's attempt to trade her for dowry, fleeing to Guangzhou in a desperate bid for freedom. Starting as a restaurant waitress, she sniffs out a business chance to earn her first fortune, then battles gang threats and industry sabotage in the garment trade. With elite heir Liang Keqing, she smashes conspiracies brick by brick. This rags-to-riches saga pulses with the grit and glory of every dream-chaser!

name: Whatever You Want
summary: Gaby Roslin presents the game show in which contestants compete for the chance to fulfil their dreams.

name: Mount Hideaway Mysteries
summary: The Mount Hideaway Mysteries series revolves around a beautiful young government operative who returns to her rural Virginia hometown and, unofficially, uses her homeschooled childhood friends to solve murders that threaten the town and a nearby secret government facility, forcing her to confront her own past and potential enemies. The series blends elements of mystery, thriller, and faith-based drama, focusing on themes of family, faith, and transitioning from childhood to adulthood.

name: Бретёр
summary: Former athlete Alexey Korin discovers that he and his friends are controlled by mysterious "Players" who treat their lives as a game. "Puppets" like him, are selected from young athletes and thrill-seekers willing to risk everything. A secret Director rules the game, but now the puppets have a chance to take control.

name: The Cancer Killers
summary: Two scientists believe they can cure cancer, but will the money men believe them? This series looks at how difficult it is to take science to market. And what about the patients?

name: The Aristocracy
summary: Series charting the changing fortunes of Britain's titled classes over the past 120 years through the archives and memories of aristocrats.

name: Ling Tian Du Zun
summary: Ling Tian, a sword saint of his generation, went against the will of heaven to seize the stele in order to save his beloved, but was plotted against by the way of heaven. When he fell, he perished together with the way of heaven, but was unexpectedly reborn, returning to the moment of his death three hundred years ago when his dantian was completely destroyed and his sword bone was taken away. His beauty is still there, his old enemy is still there, and he has been on the long road to becoming a saint, so why not start over? In this life, he vows to rewrite his destiny and make up for his regrets!

name: Hunter - Tootega Nahi, Todega
summary: ACP Vikram Chauhan, a cop with a tragic past, is accused of an aged woman Leena Thomas's death, where he sets out to prove his innocence with the help of Divya.

name: Million Dollar Extreme Presents: Extreme Peace

previousepisode.name: Sue Us For Free Pipe Bomb

name: Please See HR
summary: Please See HR is set in the Human Resources department of Miser Perpetuale, a massive, for-profit healthcare "provider" (legally, they have to put that in quotation marks).

name: Fit for TV: The Reality of the Biggest Loser
summary: Fit for TV: The Reality of The Biggest Loser is a three-part documentary series that takes an inside look at the making of the hit reality TV competition, exploring the good, the bad, and the complicated. Featuring interviews with former contestants, trainers, producers, and health professionals, the documentary examines the show's approach to transformation, the support systems in place, and the unique challenges of filming reality television. The series explores how the experience shaped the lives of those involved with the show long after the cameras stopped rolling and invites viewers to reflect on the balance between entertainment and well-being, and what it truly means to pursue lasting change.

name: Tradition & Träume: Die 2. Bundesliga 2024/25
summary: The 2. Bundesliga is home to clubs with millions of fans and a rich history. Cologne, Düsseldorf, and Magdeburg are dreaming of promotion in 2024/25. What challenges lie ahead?

name: Girl Troop vs Aliens
summary: Best friends Tilda, Kiara, Ruby and Ginny are all members of the Brighthawks – a global outward-bound association for girls – and their troop are hosting this year's annual summer camp. They're thrilled to welcome other Brighthawk troops from around the world… but they are about to discover that some attendees have come from much, much further afield! Who are these aliens? What do they want? And will our Girl Troop earn their "Planet Protector" badge.

name: La Vorágine
summary: Two rebellious lovers flee the order of the 20th century to a jungle that promises freedom, unaware that an even crueler law rules there. The story of poet Arturo Cova, who flees with his beloved Alicia. The journey takes them from Bogotá to the Eastern Plains and, finally, to the Amazon rainforest, where they must confront the harshness of their surroundings.

name: My Reno Rules
summary:
My Reno Rules sees four hardworking teams of Aussie battlers going head-to-head, breathing new life into two neighbouring rundown houses in a picturesque Melbourne suburb. Their mission? To transform these properties into breathtaking homes for the chance to win life-changing prize money to secure their own futures. But it's not just the contestants who walk away with the prize. 

In a must-watch television event, the live grand final will see two lucky Australians receive a life-changing call telling them they've both won a spectacularly renovated, multi-million-dollar home – fully furnished, landscaped and equipped with state-of-the-art technology.

name: Не в своей тарелке
summary: Only tractor driver Igor knows the truth about the alien visitors. But the district police officer, Sergei Petrovich, also feels that something is wrong in the village, so he begins an investigation. No one believes him, because the new ones unexpectedly quickly fit into rural life: Igor met those who would help raise the village, father Agafon — who would be guided to the right path, teacher Ira found a kindred spirit in the person of optimist Roma, and saleswoman Lyuba — a hero in the form of the interplanetary defender Borya. While Sveta, the mother of Borya and Roma, repairs the ship, the whole family lives in human shells. But hiding the truth is becoming more difficult due to strange events around, including beavers who have started talking thanks to an alien substance trapped in the river.

name: The Syndicate
summary: Nick Ross hosts this tactical team quiz, with two four-strong syndicates of players testing their general-knowledge and mental agility.

name: Inside the Cult of the Jesus Army
summary: It began with a dream of heaven on earth in rural Britain - but the reality was abuse on a shocking scale. From hippy origins to controlling cult, the truth is only now emerging.

name: Operation Dark Phone: Murder by Text
summary: The incredible inside story of a huge police operation to infiltrate dangerous global crime gangs through their encrypted phone network.

name: The People v. Gorilla Grodd
summary: In The People v. Gorilla Grodd, a superintelligent ape is convicted of murdering his father, the King of Gorilla City. In an eight-part "true" crime docuseries, the Daily Planet's Jimmy Olsen reopens the case, investigating whether Gorilla Grodd was wrongly convicted in one of Metropolis' most famous murder trials.

name: The Christine Jessop Story
summary: On Oct. 3, 1984, Christine Jessop went missing in Queensville, Ont. Three months later her body was found, and it would be another 35 years until the mystery was finally solved. Over three, hour-long episodes, for the first time ever, Christine's family speaks shares their story including a desperate search for answers, a falsely accused suspect, corrupt policing, revolutionary forensics, and a family forced to go through the unthinkable.

name: Power: Origins
summary: Power: Origins will continue to explore the ‘Power' universe in fresh and compelling ways, delving into the action-packed origin story of fan-favorite characters Ghost and Tommy as ambitious young entrepreneurs on the rise, determined to make their mark on the streets of New York City. A fun, rambunctious exploration of a new time period in the "Power" franchise, "Power: Origins" will highlight the unbridled audacity of young men not just leveling up, but determined to become legends in the game.

name: Football Families
summary:
This July, RTÉ presents Football Families, a three-part documentary series featuring Shelbourne Football club's most promising young talent from across the country as they strive to make it as professional footballers.

The series offers unique behind-the-scenes access to Shelbourne F.C., filmed during their historic 2024 season under manager Damien Duff. For Shelbourne fans, 2024 was the stuff of dreams, with both the men and women's senior teams winning titles, and the underage squads making a big impact throughout the elite development leagues.

Each episode of Football Families tells the stories of different young players and their families, whose lives revolve around football. These teenagers are committed to achieving their dreams in the face of extreme pressure, injuries, and setbacks.

The series follows them as they endeavour to make the big step up to the league champion squad in the dog-eat-dog world of professional football. The chances of making it are slim.

name: Hallmark Channel's Countdown to Christmas
summary: Kicking off at the end of October and running through Christmas, Countdown to Christmas is Hallmark Channel's annual holiday themed movies.

name: Young Millionaires
summary: Friday the 13th in Marseille, childhood friends Samia, Léo, David and Jess hit the lottery jackpot. But at 17, it's impossible to cash the ticket... the first problem of a long series, because hitting the jackpot at this age opens the door to an avalanche of problems. Because you can't be serious when you're 17 with 17 million!

name: Timeline
summary: Brian Conley presents Timeline, where three teams of two compete against not only each other but also an ever decreasing time limit in order to bank as much money as possible.

name: Stjernebryllup
summary: In the brand new series Stjernebryllup, viewers get an insight into three spectacular celebrity weddings, as three couples in love are ready to say their respective yeses to each other.

name: Dyreklinikken
summary: At Lisaklinikken in Oslo, all pet owners who for various reasons cannot pay for veterinary treatment can come and get free help. This is a very special clinic, run by Animal Protection Norway, and run by general manager Caroline Holtet.

name: Smak & ubehag
summary: Bernt Hulsker says he has zero knowledge of food, and always goes for the safest option on the menu when on vacation. That will end now. When Bernt was visited by Kjartan Skjelde who was cleaning up his home earlier this spring, he realized that this was a friend worth spending time with, and learning more from. Bernt has therefore invited his new, good friend and master chef along on a gastronomic journey around Europe.

name: Mødre
summary: They are mothers, but also celebrities. In this series we follow Birgit Skarstein, Karianne Vilde Spetalen, Ulrikke Brandstorp and Linni Meister through their ups and downs. It gives a close look at how they balance celebrity life and parenthood.

name: Jul med Charterfeber
summary: When the nights get long and the cold sets in. Yes, then it's Jul med Charterfeber! In this brand new series, some of the most popular southern tourists open their doors to their homes, when they exchange sunshine for snow chaos. Stein Are and the Harstad family get ready for the Christmas celebration and get their feet wet to get a Christmas tree, and the Buskerud ladies go to Oslo for some big-city shopping (and the occasional naked man), while Roger prepares food in his very own way.

name: The Mighty Nein
summary: The Mighty Nein follows a group of fugitives and outcasts, bound by secrets and scars. But when a powerful arcane relic known as "The Beacon" falls into dangerous hands, they must learn to work together to save the realm and stop reality itself from unraveling.

name: Teskilat-i Mahsusa Trablus
summary: After the Italian occupation in Tripoli, Major Enver, who saw that the Ottoman Empire was in a difficult situation, went to Tripoli with his patriotic friends like Mustafa Kemal, to organize the natives to drive out the invaders.

name: A Sorority Mom's Guide to Rush!
summary: Each hour-long episode follows two mother-daughter duos as they navigate the emotionally charged path towards their goal sorority. Bringing guidance, glam and a lot of honesty to the journey are two breakout names from the world of Rush: New York Times profiled consultant Bill Alverson and The Queen of #RushTok, Brandis Bradley. With their expertise, they help these families prepare their daughters to make a lasting impression to land a spot in their top-tier house. These moms, daughters and even grandmothers and siblings will do anything it takes to help get them accepted into their legacy sororities, making them sisters in every sense. A Sorority Mom's Guide to Rush! goes beyond the filters and fanfare to reveal the love, legacy and ambition that drives these women to do whatever it takes for that coveted spot.

name: Pluribus
summary: The most miserable person on Earth must save the world from happiness.

name: Wolfenstein
summary: U.S. World War II solider William "B.J." Blazkowicz goes behind enemy lines to fight the Nazis, only to discover they are engaging in bizarre experiments and the occult in an attempt to tip the scales of the war in their favor.

name: President Curtis
summary: President Curtis follows the Commander-in-Chief and his eccentric staff as they tackle the kind of crises that Rick Sanchez could never be bothered with - from interdimensional diplomacy to paranormal investigations and unexplained phenomena.

name: Live PD: Rewind
summary: Highlighted moments from "Live PD.". Following police departments from across the country as they patrol their communities.

name: Black Surfers Matter
summary: Californian surf culture seems to exude effortless coolness. But behind the façade lies a murky past, and a problematic present of Hollywood whitewashing, swastikas, and racism.

name: Chuai Diao Zha Fu Hou，Wo Zhuan Shen Cheng Le She Zheng Wang Fei
Love And Hate With You. Let It Be.
Utsukushii Rinjin
summary: A sudden encounter between a gracefully attractive but mysterious woman, Saki, and an ordinary housewife, Eriko, who has a happy family, causes Eriko's serene daily life to fall apart. Eriko's husband, Shinji becomes the target of Saki's advances and finds himself caught between her and his wife.

name: Runaway
summary: With only 168 HOURS left before death claims her, Winrawi finds herself the target of a relentless, vengeful spirit whose dark presence draws closer with each passing second. A chilling voice whispers hoarsely, threatening to take her life and pushing her to the brink of despair. Desperate and alone, she encounters a woman with a cold, indifferent gaze - the only person who holds hope of escape from this haunting pursuit, but her plea is met with merciless rejection. As time slips away, Winrawi is forced to confront the shadows of her past, unraveling secrets that reveal a horrifying truth, spiraling toward a tragedy no one could have foreseen.

name: Play Park
summary: An unexpected romance that blossoms in the colorful setting of an amusement park between Lilin, a heir to a powerful family business, and Ing Ing, the diligent amusement park manager.

name: Like a Palette
summary: Jane is confused about whether P'Dai's feelings are just kindness or if it's something more special!? We'll have to wait and see just when Jane will realize she's being courted!

name: Жизнь заново
summary: Year 2026. The life of Dima, a forty-year-old ER doctor, has gone downhill: his wife left him, his colleagues despise him, and alcohol has become his best friend. But one day, during an MRI, Dima is suddenly transported to 2002. He's an eighteen-year-old again, his mother is alive, the love of his life is still available, and the fateful meeting with his ex-wife hasn't happened. He has a chance to live his life anew and, perhaps, fix everything.

name: Be my angel
summary: Jane is chasing her dream of opening a Shio Pan bakery. However, opportunity never seems to knock. Finally, Jane turns to a merit-collecting application called "Lucky Points". Jane makes three wishes: a large sum of capital, a rental building at a great price, and someone who will love and stay by her side. Unfortunately, her accumulated merit points aren't enough. Jane accidentally says, "Can't I just ask for someone?", the system picks up that sentence and processes it as a new official request. The next morning, Jane wakes up to find Z, a handsome angel who is the "someone" Jane asked for. Z has been assigned to look after her for three months. However, this blessing from heaven comes with chaos. Z turns out to be a low-ranking, unskilled angel who can barely do anything.

name: Un-trovert
summary: A chaotic love story between a heart-shielded introverted girl and a confident extrovert who's never afraid of love. Opposites… but perfect together. Serenity meets a storm of emotions. But in the end, will this reserved girl dare to unlock her heart for love?

name: Romantics Anonymous
summary: Thanks to their love of chocolate, Sosuke and Hana have a chance encounter. However, due to their social anxiety, Sosuke can't touch, and Hana can't make eye contact, which brings unique challenges to their budding relationship.

name: Frontlinie
summary: Documentary series in which Bram Vermeulen poignantly reveals forgotten international stories about developments that are often no more than a footnote in our daily news.

name: Betting on Beloit
summary: America's richest self-made woman Diane Hendricks is betting big on the town integral to her family's success. Betting on Beloit chronicles the billionaire entrepreneur and her driven, accomplished daughter Konya Hendricks Schuh's mission to revitalize Beloit, Wisconsin. The show follows Konya and her dynamic team—which includes her husband Matt (a plumbing contractor and former home builder), good friend and project manager Pete, and her realtor nephew Connor, as well as local artisans and designer friends Kristin and Mitch—as they purchase, restore and reimagine historic homes throughout Beloit's storied neighborhoods.

name: Nachtstreife
summary:
The "Nachtstreife" is back in Mainz. The fifth season accompanies Mainz police officers during their nighttime patrols in their fight against violence and crime. Every night, officers from the uniformed police, the criminal investigation department, and the highway police face new challenges: racism, violence in close social relationships, alcohol consumption, acts of violence, death, homophobia.

The ARD docu-soap provides an exclusive and unadulterated insight into the demanding work of the Mainz police and shows the people behind the uniform. How do they feel when they make the city a little safer night after night? Are there police operations that are particularly stressful for them?

The show features people who do their job out of conviction, who are trained professionals and want to come home healthy after a shift. The format is purely documentary.

"Nachtstreife" accompanies police officers from Mainz (SWR) and Hamburg (NDR, season 4).

name: Because I Don't Want To Go Home
summary: What's wrong with going on a trip alone with a friend of the opposite sex? Yoon Seul who doesn't want to go home and Han Bit who doesn't want to go to the army begin their friendship trip! Wait no I mean, the friendship-destroying romance begins!

previousepisode.name: EP3: Friendship with a male friend is broken

name: Pharaohs at War
summary:
Pharaohs at War explores four epic battles that changed the fate of Ancient Egypt: Megiddo, Qadesh, Raphia, and Actium. These decisive confrontations between pharaohs and their greatest rivals defined the legacy of one of history's most iconic civilisations.

Each episode focuses on a high-stakes duel between a pharaoh and a formidable enemy. Through expert interviews and 3D reconstructions, the series unveils the military strategies, political motives, and human drama behind these legendary conflicts. The series follows archaeologists into the field as they uncover spectacular sites—some revealed for the first time on screen. Clue by clue, these discoveries shed light on how war reshaped Egypt's destiny.

name: Restarted Love
summary: After years of marriage, young artist Lu Ming and his wife Xu Xin begin to grow emotionally distant, as their once-strong bond starts to crack. In a severe car accident, Xu Xin is critically injured and falls into a prolonged coma at the hospital. At home, Lu Ming discovers a stream-of-consciousness novel written by Xu Xin. Lu Ming realizes that the novel reflects Xu Xin's unspoken emotions and her deep love for him. After reading the novel, Lu Ming regrets his past actions and rewrites its ending. Eventually, Xu Xin awakens slowly to Lu Ming's calls…

name: Shi Zun Shi Ge Wei Xian Zhi Ye
Krigsmaskinen Sverige
summary: Documentary series where Per Wallin and Mattis Bergwall, who together make the War History podcast, take a bold approach to Sweden's own history and reveal the stories of preparedness that are rarely discussed.

name: Gao Men Zhu Mu Tai Xiong Meng
Leng Qing Zong Men ， Ni Hou Hui Le Ma
Spring Rewritten
summary: The heiress of a merchant guild, Zhao Chunman, infiltrates the Yuchun Opera House to avenge her father's death, but tragically dies at the hands of Zhou Chi, the second-in-command of the Yi Gang. Time resets, and Zhao Chunman realizes things may not be as they seemed. Determined to uncover the truth behind her father's death and change her own fate, Chunman repeatedly faces critical choices, treading carefully with each step while also gradually winning ground in her complex relationship with Zhou Chi.

name: Vikings: The Making of an Empire
summary: An immersive journey that chronicles the epic rise and fall of history's first-and-only Viking empire. Harald Bluetooth, his son Sven Forkbeard, and grandson Cnut the Great, were larger-than-life conquerors who built a sophisticated culture that transformed the image of Vikings from fearsome marauders to respectable Christian rulers. Featuring contributions by the world's leading experts, it's a riveting story of power, betrayal, and ambition that changed the course of history.

name: Dangerous Love
summary: Xu Beisheng vows to avenge her father by staying in the household of the warlord—the man who killed his father. Learning of a marriage alliance between the Xu and Zhou families, he meticulously plots to sabotage the union by getting close to Zhou Menghuan. However, his calculated approach crumbles as genuine feelings unexpectedly blossom. When his deception is exposed, a transformed Zhou Menghuan turns the tables, marrying into the Xu family to seek revenge. The two fall into a cycle of love and hatred amid the power struggles of wealthy clans, ultimately swept away by the tide of the war-torn era.

name: My Foxfoe Queen
summary: The entire fox clan was exterminated by Crown Prince Xiling Xuan of Xiling Kingdom. The fox clan's saintess, Tushan Yue, managed to preserve a fragment of her soul and pursued Xiling Xuan to the royal palace of Xiling Kingdom for revenge. Tushan Yue's remaining soul attaches to the body of the late Empress Jiang Xin'er. As her revenge plan unfolds, Tushan Yue uncovers a shocking truth.

name: Princess Revenge
summary: Heiress Dongfang Xi, for the sake of love, hides her identity and works to support the scoundrel Ye Yunzhou, only to be betrayed by him. Upon awakening, she realizes she is the villainous supporting female in a novel. She makes a bet with a system to change her fate and ultimately exposes Ye Yunzhou's true nature at the return banquet. When Ye Yunzhou entangles her again, she discovers that her secret admirer, Dongfang Yan, is actually the system incarnate, but deliberately loses the bet before a turning point in her destiny, revealing the love he had hidden for years.

name: Fast Friends
summary: Game show hosted by Les Dawson in which two team captains have 30 seconds to make Fast Friends.

name: Stupid Central
summary: Babatunde Aléshé presents funny videos from the internet.

name: The Moors Murders: A Search for Justice
summary: Six decades of suffering for the victims' families and a case that shook the nation. Revelations and newly uncovered evidence as experts pursue answers and, ultimately, justice.

name: Japan's Master of Restoration
summary: Where broken beauty is reborn. How legendary art restorer Koji Mayuyama is preserving ancient treasures, one divine touch at a time.

name: Becoming Charlie
summary:
Who am I?

Charlie feels like neither a woman nor a man. But then what is Charlie? The coming-of-age series Becoming Charlie follows Charlie on a quest for identity.

name: Higher
summary: Instructor Jiang Zhen from the "Gale Training Camp" goes undercover in the Amethyst Group to investigate a fatal accident caused by a self-driving car, following the death of his younger sister Xiaotong. During the mission, he crosses paths with his former partner and now sworn enemy Bai Fan. Despite the initial suspicion, the two eventually join forces to uncover the truth behind the car accident years ago. They also discover evidence of the Amethyst Group's crimes involving brain-computer interface technology. Later, together with Nong Qianya, who also suffered persecution at the hands of the Nong family, they destroy the conspiracy of Amethyst Group's chairman, Nong Cangqin, in one go.

name: The Miracles
summary: This series centers on the theme of creating "miracles," spotlighting Shenzhen's remarkable achievements over the 45 years of reform and opening-up as well as its vision for the future. Through artistic storytelling, it showcases the city's unique spirit and youthful vitality.

name: Hua Jian Jiu Ren Jian Yue
Be Not Meant to Be
summary: In the Republic of China era, Ye Nanzhao suffers betrayal by her former husband and the tragic loss of her daughter. On her way to report to the authorities, she is abducted and forced to assume the identity of a dead woman, becoming the second concubine of the Lu household. By a twist of fate, her treacherous ex-husband turns out to be the Lu family's new son-in-law. To make matters worse, the woman she's impersonating has left behind an absolute mess.

name: Xiao Fang
summary: It tells the story of Yang Xiaofang and Qi Xiaowei from the same village, who become pregnant before marriage. The Yang family rushes back to the village to help Xiaofang plan her next steps. The Qi and Yang families hold different attitudes, unexpectedly stirring up a "marital storm." After negotiations between the two families break down, Xiaofang goes on blind dates while pregnant, only to become the center of attention in the entire village, sparking a series of laugh-out-loud incidents.

name: Serial Homicide
summary: The tranquility of Luzhou City is shattered by a series of murders disguised as "punishing the wicked and promoting the good." The public security authorities have formed the "909 Task Force" to investigate the case. After going through numerous difficulties, the task force gradually unveils the shocking truth behind the "Erinyes" murder and revenge plan.

name: Voyage to Haihun
summary: Wang Heng, a frustrated young man, accidentally travels back to the Western Han Dynasty. There, he encounters De Jiu, a female swordsman who strongly resembles his ex-girlfriend, and forms a deep friendship with Liu He, an outgoing man. Determined to team up and challenge history, the trio tries to rewrite Liu He's fate—he was once a short-lived emperor who only reigned for 27 days. Together, they embark on a bold, cross-temporal adventure to defy destiny...

name: Les Enquêtes Caméléon
summary: Louis Constantin, nicknamed "Chameleon," is a retired detective from the PJ. He keeps himself busy by conducting investigations on behalf of the CIA (insurance company), with the help of his family: his wife Charlotte (the energetic Dany Carrel), his daughter Isabelle (the bubbly Sabine Paturel), and his son Alex! Between The Pink Panther and Inspector Gadget, everyone has their own method for flushing out imposters...

name: Il était deux fois
summary:
2013. Searching for her missing daughter, Captain Gabrielle Moscato falls asleep in a hotel room only to wake up… in 2025, with no memory of the intervening twelve years. Atypical psychogenic amnesia has erased her memory but hasn't altered her instincts as a cop, nor her instincts as a mother.

How far will she go to save her daughter?

Or rather, how far has it already gone?

name: Flower Sea
summary: One morning, after woke up, Chen Jing'an and Zhu Niannian found their souls were swapped. Jing'an becomes the "heiress of a wealthy family," while Niannian turns into the "younger sister" of her secret crush. But as they team up with Chen Changning, who maybe uncover the truth, to investigate the reason of the drama, more chaos and obstacles arise. The situation also becomes more and more unpredictable.

name: Wow the World
summary: Wow The World takes viewers on a global journey with its guests, uncovering local cultures and cuisines while promoting environmental and charitable values. The show features immersive challenges such as ingredient foraging, cooking competitions, and cultural exploration. It offers a vibrant glimpse into the unique charm of different regions and the fusion of diverse cultures.

previousepisode.name: Episode 7 (Part 2): Global Cast Tours Barcelona, Charmingly Calling Everyone "Sis"

name: Rearrange
summary: Win loses both his best friend Nut and their shared music dream. One day, he's taken back to age 17 and reunites with Nut. As they form a band and chase their dream, changing the past risks losing Nut again. Can Win make it right this time?

name: Police Tactical Unit
summary: At the heart of the action is the Mobile Unit, an elite tactical team within Rongcheng's Criminal Investigation Division. Crime scenes are their domain, for example, a meticulously staged celebrity suicide, a masterfully planned heist, a perfectly concealed drug den, a cop ambush laced with traps, and so on. Criminals may set elaborate decoys, but they are no match for the detectives' sharp eyes.

name: Miss Dong Spends Valentine's Day Every Day
Red Dance Shoes
summary: In the 1970s and 1980s, the story follows a group of young performers in a military arts troupe as they chase their dreams on stage. Amid social change, reform, love and difficult life choices, they grow into outstanding dancers and dedicate their youth to the army and their country.

name: The Formless City
summary: When young coroner Xu Linlang is swept into the underworld by a bloody massacre, she joins forces with Lu Jiu and Sima Kong. This unlikely trio navigates a labyrinth of power, where factions like Wuxiang City weave deadly schemes, uncovering truths while forging bonds in the shadowy underworld.

name: Threads of Destiny
summary: Both of the Jiang family's daughters are reborn. Jiang Xueying, the eldest daughter of the Jiang family, swaps her marriage with her younger sister Jiang Yu'er. As the prince's wife, Jiang Xueying battles cunning rivals in the household, including Jiang Yu'er. She reforms her reckless husband and joins forces with him to expose a sinister conspiracy.

name: The Nameless Season
summary: Grade 12 in high school, a season between spring and summer that will never come again. It's hot and sweaty and the sound of summer bugs fills the air. Do Wan feels anxious as he senses that his time with Jae Yul is running out.

previousepisode.name: Now You Know All My Feelings

name: The Hospital
summary: The Hospital, a new satirical sketch comedy series that offers a behind-the-scenes look at what happens when you mix improv comedy with ‘total medical negligence.

name: That's ACA
summary:
A Current Affair, Australia's most-watched daily current affairs program, has launched a new weekly podcast, That's ACA, taking listeners and viewers behind the scenes of the show's most talked-about stories.

Hosted by seasoned reporters Steve Marshall and Lizzie Pearl, That's ACA offers a candid look into the world of television reporting. Each week, the hosts dissect the biggest stories, share their personal experiences on the road and talk to the program's stable of reporters about the weird and wonderful assignments that capture the nation's attention.

name: TheatreDome
summary:
Step inside the TheatreDome for an exhilarating battle of wits and theatrical fun, premiering weekdays from August 4 at 7.30am on 9Go! and 9Now.
 
TheatreDome is an electrifying new series bringing a fresh wave of creativity and fun to children's television. Breaking new ground, TheatreDome reworks the traditional improv format to resonate with young Aussies, standing out as Australia's first improvisational shows for children.
 
Aspiring drama students step inside the TheatreDome for a series of hilarious improv sketch battles. Guided by professional mentors known as "The Oracles", two teams, The Fates and The Muses, go head-to-head within the mysterious TheatreDome, under the watchful eye of The Great Overseer. The ultimate goal? To be crowned the undisputed champion of the TheatreDome!

name: Миллиард проблем
summary: The Kalachevs save on everything, and their father, school teacher Rostik, keeps track of expenses in a notebook and dreams of a grant. The family is not discouraged, participating in relay races, lotteries and competitions where they can win a useful prize. Everything changes when Rostik gets a winning ticket for 1,000,000,000 rubles. It would seem that now the Kalachevs have nothing to worry about, because they are provided for for life. But with the appearance of big money, big problems appear...

name: Half Awake in a Fleeting Dream
summary: Yin Zheng seeks revenge for her mother and meets Prince Wen Ze under unexpected circumstances. As they search for the truth, they overcome misunderstandings and develop trust and love for each other.

name: Kumo no Kaidan
summary: Saburo works at a medical office on The Izu Islands, which has seen its population dwindle over the years. Even though Saburo doesn't have a medical license, he performs operations under the instructions of Dr. Muraki. Because of his gifted dexterity and sincerity, people call him the Young Doctor. Saburo becomes conflicted over his position, but he convinces himself that what he is doing is helping people. Saburo is also loved by nurse Akiko Suzuki and Akiko Tasaka, who is the daughter of the director of a general hospital in Tokyo.

name: Confidence Man
summary: A comedy-drama that depicts three crooks extorting large sums of money from people who are stained with desire with grand and unusual plans on the stage of the colorful world of real estate and finance.

name: 16 лет и 9 месяцев
summary: The main character Tonya is 16 years old, she is an excellent student, is engaged in dancing and is crazy about the main handsome boy of the school, Semyon. To please him, Tonya tries to appear older and lies that she has been dating guys for a long time. But for Semyon, a date with Tonya is just entertainment, and for Tony it's the first time. In a couple of weeks, she finds out that she is pregnant. The girl cannot admit to anyone what happened and finds herself all alone in front of the most difficult choice. Tony's classmate Mitya suddenly becomes the only one who lends a shoulder. Under the yoke of condemnation from parents and the public, the heroine will have to go through a difficult path.

name: My Awkward Senpai
summary: Kannawa has a secret: Even though she has a reputation in the office as intense, strict, and scary, she's actually just…awkward. So, when she learns she has to train Kamegawa, the cute, nerdy newbie, she's at a complete loss! Can this awkward senpai figure out how to handle her budding feelings?!

previousepisode.name: I Really Thought About It, Ya Know?!

name: Кто куда
summary: «Kto kuda» is not just a travel show, it is a real travel game, where the hosts become players. Here they do not rely on fate and do not toss coins: Leo and Angelica choose where they will go themselves and compete for a place in a luxury hotel. For one day, the hosts go to different parts of Russia to get to know the city and its color better with the help of specially prepared tasks for each other. Whoever passes the tests faster gets the right to spend the night in the most luxurious hotel. The loser will spend the night in an ordinary cheap hostel.

name: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball
summary: Welcome back to Elmore, where the laws of reality are a joke, and family life is anything but ordinary. Whether he's battling an evil fast-food empire, facing off against a sentient AI in love with his mom, or trying to stop Banana Joe from wearing pants, Gumball Watterson drags his brother Darwin, sister Anais, and the rest of the town of Elmore along for the ride.
